why: arXiv:2310.01219 (Gong et al., updated Feb 2025) claims the Novikov conjecture holds for discrete subgroups of the diffeomorphism group of a compact smooth manifold, removing an earlier volume-preserving restriction; this narrows the fundamental-group cases for which the conjecture is verified, but it is unclear whether this counts as a new case versus incremental strengthening of prior known-case results, so I could not confidently tell how much territory it removes.
